result.brief: 该文质疑线性探针能否证明预训练视觉模型具有线性表征，提出反向可预测性、谱集中度与分布外泛化三项诊断，区分线性世界模型与核机几何，并在多个视觉基准上验证。
result.reason: Analyzes whether linear probes evidence linear structure in pretrained vision transformer representations, proposing diagnostics for latent geometry—directly about visual representation learning.
